Swiss Army Bench 0.0.21: extensions install with the tray icon running.

- **Install and Remove on the Extensions page work with the tray icon running.** In 0.0.20 the install stopped
  the app and waited for the tray to close; the tray only checks in every few seconds, never heard, and stayed,
  so the install gave up after a minute with "The app did not stop." The install now closes the tray itself
  after a moment and the app comes back with a fresh one. The same goes for an update started from a page.

Update from the tray icon's own menu (right-click, Update to 0.0.21): it closes the tray itself, so this update
cannot meet the problem it fixes. Or:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
